d:
The Pink Line, part of Namma Metro’s Phase 2 network, was flagged off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on November 13.
What do Bengaluru's citizens have to say about the partial opening of Pink Line? Can the new corridor realistically help ease city's notorious traffic congestion and improve daily commute? Beyond the Pink Line, how should Bengaluru plan its larger urban mobility strategy?
Reporting: Nalme Nachiyar, Darshan Devaiah
Video: Ravichandran N, Sudhakara Jain, Allen Egenuse J
Editing: Ravichandran N
Thank you for watching our video!
